name: Single-core cable sealing end
summary: The termination at the end of a single-core cable where it is sealed and connected to an overhead line or equipment.
description: A sealing end terminates a cable by controlling the electric stress at the screen cut-back, sealing out moisture and providing a connection to the conductor. The single-core form appears at each phase of medium and high voltage single-core cable circuits, typically at the cable to overhead line transition or at outdoor switchyard equipment.

The symbol does not show whether the termination is indoor or outdoor, heat-shrink, cold-shrink or porcelain, nor how the cable screen is bonded. Screen bonding at sealing ends, for example solid bonding or single-point bonding with sheath voltage limiters, must be drawn separately.
readingNotes: Check the screen bonding arrangement at each sealing end.
Look for surge arresters fitted beside outdoor sealing ends.
drawingChecklist: State termination type and voltage class.
Show screen bonding at the termination.
Identify the equipment or line the sealing end connects to.
distinction: A sealing end terminates a cable; a straight-through joint connects two cable lengths together.
